name: Table summary
description: Column-level summary statistics and distribution plots for any table. Numeric columns get count, mean, standard deviation, minimum, median and maximum; text, boolean and date columns get the number of distinct values and the most frequent value. Up to max_columns numeric columns are drawn as small-multiple histograms, coloured by the group role when the dataset maps one.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: Any dataset. Roles are optional; a mapped group role colours the histograms and a mapped sample role adds a sample count.

max_columns.title: Numeric columns to plot
max_columns.description: At most this many numeric columns (in table order) get a histogram panel.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: One row per column with type, counts and summary statistics.

outputs.name: distributions
outputs.description: Small-multiple histograms of the numeric columns.

citation: Built with pandas (McKinney 2010; The pandas development team, https://pandas.pydata.org), NumPy (Harris et al. 2020, https://numpy.org) and Plotly (Plotly Technologies Inc., https://plotly.com/python/). See README.md for details.
